include_homepage_link.description: Set to 'yes' to include a link to the pgn2web homepage in the generated HTML. Corresponds to the -c option.

piece_set.description: The visual set for chess pieces. Corresponds to the -p option. Valid values include adventurer, alfonso-x, cases, condal, harlequin, kingdom, leipzig, line, lucena, magnetic, mark, marroquin, maya, mediaeval, merida, motif.

layout_style.description: The layout format for the generated webpages. Corresponds to the -s option. Valid values are frameset, linked, or individual.

pgn_input.description: The path to the input PGN chess games file.

html_output.description: The path to the output HTML file to be generated.
